title: The triage dispatch pass runs from its spec

story.i_want_to: the triage pass to be the :judge archetype driven by triage@1
story.so_that: the next :judge agent reuses the pass instead of copying TriageDispatcher

rationale: TriageDispatcher.run_with/2 hard-codes the payload, refs, transient and blocked classification, and the stranded sweep (triage_dispatcher.ex:323-447).

acceptance_criteria.description: Loopctl.Agents.Dispatcher.run(spec, opts) runs a :judge pass: candidates, payload builder (:fenced_intake_report), refs (:base_as_branch), the too-large escalation, transient/blocked classification and the spec's sweeps ([:stranded_triaged]).
TriageDispatchWorker calls it with triage@1; the outcome summary it logs and the Runners.dispatch payload maps are byte-identical to today's on recorded fixtures.
The :dispatch_driver_enabled switch still stops the pass.

test_cases.name: same payloads
steps: record today's dispatch payloads on a fixture corpus

test_cases.name: same outcomes
steps: run both passes over the corpus with no runner, one runner, and an exhausted runner
